product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system for physiotherapy clinics that combines traditional clinical management features with advanced Artificial Intelligence assistance to optimize patient care, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes to enhance operational efficiency.
Improve quality and precision of clinical documentation through AI-powered tools.
Enhance patient engagement and satisfaction via personalized portals and communication channels.
Provide comprehensive management features including patient care, scheduling, financials, and inventory.
Deliver actionable analytics and reporting for clinical and business decision-making.
key_features: Comprehensive Patient Management with detailed medical history, interactive 3D body maps, and secure media attachments.
Advanced Scheduling System supporting multiple therapists, conflict prevention, recurring appointments, and notifications.
Clinical Documentation with rich text SOAP notes, auto-save, version control, and AI-generated reports.
AI Assistant integration with Google Gemini AI for automatic report generation, treatment suggestions, risk analysis, and clinical queries.
Extensive Exercise Library with media-rich content, categories, difficulty levels, and personalized prescriptions.
Patient Portal providing secure access to personal records, prescribed exercises, scheduling, and direct clinic communication.
Interactive Dashboards displaying operational metrics, financial KPIs, and clinical analytics with exportable reports.
Robust Financial Management including payment tracking, revenue reports, and multi-payment integration (PIX, credit card).
Inventory Control with stock alerts and movement history for clinic materials and equipment.
Communication CRM integrated with WhatsApp for patient engagement and notifications.
Teleconsultation capabilities with video conferencing, scheduling, and session history.
Gamification system to increase patient engagement through achievements and challenges.
Educational Materials library with videos and articles for professionals and patients.
Secure Authentication system with role-based access control and password recovery options.
user_flow_summary: User registers or logs in through a secure authentication system with role-based access.
Administrators manage clinic operations including finances, inventory, and user roles.
Physiotherapists manage patient information, schedule appointments, document clinical notes, and utilize AI-assisted treatment recommendations.
Patients access their portal to view history, exercises, appointment schedules and communicate with the clinic.
Clinic staff schedule and manage appointments with drag-and-drop calendar views and conflict resolution.
System generates AI-powered clinical reports and analytics dashboards for ongoing evaluation.
Automated notifications and reminders are sent to patients and professionals for engagements and appointments.
Inventory and financial management flows support clinic operational workflows with alerts and reporting.
validation_criteria: Patient records can be created, edited, and deleted with data validation and duplication checks.
Appointments support multi-therapist scheduling with conflict prevention and recurring series.
Clinical notes include rich text editing, auto-save functionality, template usage, and version history.
AI modules generate physiotherapy reports, protocol suggestions and risk analyses with at least 95% accuracy.
Exercise library contains categorized, media-rich entries supporting personalized plans.
Patient portal securely authenticates users and provides real-time access to personal health data and scheduling.
Dashboards and reports present accurate, exportable data with interactive visualization.
Financial transactions and inventory movements are tracked and alerts generated on threshold breaches.
System complies with LGPD requirements including data encryption, audit logs, and role-based access controls.
Performance metrics meet sub-2-second page load times and 99.5% system availability standards.
